title: Patient Invoices & Statements Billing Class Attributes
content:
Five attributes of Patient Invoices & Statements are fixed by billing class: whether the class is paid at purchase, whether its invoices can join a payment plan, whether they can receive a financial-assistance discount, whether a signed ABN option 1 is required for a Medicare denial to appear on them, and when an invoice closes once its balance reaches zero.

| | Self-Pay Patient Invoice | Consumer Test Purchase Invoice | Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice | Out-of-Network Balance Invoice | Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice | Medicaid Copay Invoice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paid in full at purchase, before testing | No | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Can be enrolled in a payment plan | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Can receive a financial-assistance discount | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Signed ABN option 1 on the order required for a Medicare denial to appear on the invoice | No | No | No | No | Yes | No |
| Invoice closes, calendar days after the balance reaches zero | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Attribute notes

- **Paid at purchase** describes a class paid in full at purchase before testing; only the Consumer Test Purchase Invoice is such a class.
- **Payment plan** states whether the invoice can be enrolled in a payment plan. The Consumer Test Purchase Invoice and the Medicaid Copay Invoice cannot.
- **Financial assistance** states whether the invoice can receive a financial-assistance discount. Every class can except the Consumer Test Purchase Invoice.
- **ABN option 1** states whether a signed ABN option 1 must be on the order for a Medicare denial to appear on the invoice. It is required only on the Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice.
- **Closing** gives the calendar days after the balance reaches zero on which the invoice closes; 0 on every class means the invoice closes on the day its balance reaches zero.

## Profiles at a glance

| Billing class | Prepaid | Payment plan | Financial assistance | ABN option 1 required |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Self-Pay Patient Invoice | no | yes | yes | no |
| Consumer Test Purchase Invoice | yes | no | no | no |
| Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice | no | yes | yes | no |
| Out-of-Network Balance Invoice | no | yes | yes | no |
| Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Medicaid Copay Invoice | no | no | yes | no |
